rows.subtype: Hunger and sleep turn into tantrums [Actor]
rows.description: A toddler melts down over small things when hungry or tired, and a meal or nap changes the mood; body needs come before manners or reasoning.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Teacher notices a child cannot focus before snack [Observer]
rows.description: A teacher sees a child fidgeting and tearful before break, calm after eating; unmet basic needs often look like bad behaviour.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A schoolchild who came without breakfast thinks only of food and cannot follow the lesson; the mind narrows to the pressing need and higher goals fade.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Sleep loss changes mood and choices [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager up late every night grows irritable, impulsive and low, and takes worse decisions; steady sleep and regular meals protect mood and judgment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A student surviving on tea and little sleep snaps at friends and makes rash choices before exams, then regrets them; rested bodies think and forgive better.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Long scarcity leaves little room for planning [Observer]
rows.description: A person short of food, sleep or safe shelter for long has little mental room for future planning, which reflects scarcity and not laziness; support and stable basics free the mind.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child lost for an hour in drawing or building forgets time and prizes; curiosity and joy in the task itself are early signs of a mind growing toward its own potential.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: joy, affection, curiosity

rows.description: A teenager keeps learning classical music despite jokes from classmates, since it feels true to them; growth begins where inner interest outweighs the wish to fit in.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young adult turns down a high-paying, famous job for work that fits their values, and feels both fear and calm; the path fits them better than the applause would.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A mentor notices a young person light up and stay late for their own interest, not for marks, and gives them space and tools instead of pressing them toward a set career.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
